primitive.relation: pairs of supplied vertex sets of one simple graph, three contracts kept apart: disjoint anticompleteness, raw anticompleteness and cross completeness. Chromatic X3, Extremal X57/X58/X223 x*_anticomplete ([disjoint A & B] /\ a -- b -> False for cross pairs) and Minor X11 x11_anticomplete_sets (the same with ~~ (x -- y)) are iffs with GTBase.set_pairs.anticomplete A B ([disjoint A & B] && ~~ neighbor A B) by anticompleteP / anticomplete_nonadjP; GTMisc X41/X144 x*_anticomplete_between (~~ (a -- b) for cross pairs, no disjointness) are iffs with upstream ~~ neighbor A B by neighborNP; GTMisc X41/X144 x*_complete_between (a -- b for cross pairs) are iffs with GTBase.set_pairs.complete_between A B by complete_betweenP; Extremal D2ram complete_bipartite_sub ([disjoint A & B] /\ cross completeness) is an iff with complete_between A B by disjoint_complete_betweenP, cross completeness forcing disjointness on an sgraph (complete_between_disjoint). No nonempty, order or unequal-vertex guard; completeness in compl G equals raw anticompleteness in G only for disjoint parts (complete_between_compl).

disjoint-anticomplete.note: [disjoint A & B] /\ (forall cross pairs, a -- b -> False); iff with anticomplete A B by anticompleteP

disjoint-anticomplete-boolean-negation.note: [disjoint A & B] /\ (forall cross pairs, ~~ (x -- y)); iff with anticomplete A B by anticomplete_nonadjP

raw-anticomplete.note: forall cross pairs, ~~ (a -- b), with no disjointness; iff with upstream ~~ neighbor A B by neighborNP

raw-complete.note: forall cross pairs, a -- b; iff with complete_between A B by complete_betweenP

disjoint-complete.note: [disjoint A & B] /\ (forall cross pairs, a -- b); iff with complete_between A B by disjoint_complete_betweenP (cross completeness forces disjointness on an sgraph)
